decisions.reason: As a newly launched loader closely aligned with the firm's core underground-equipment capabilities and customer base, there is no clear evidence of performance below aspiration, so boundedly rational management would retain it while learning from the market and using available slack to refine the offer.

As a newly launched underground dump truck that complements the firm's specialized mining portfolio, the absence of a visible shortfall and the strategic fit with existing engineering, service and customer relationships make continued support more likely than an early withdrawal.
